title: West Pakistan Essential Articles Control Sindh Amendment Act 1972

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Essential Articles Control Sindh Amendment Act 1972
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XVI OF 1972
ACT XVI OF 1972
WEST PAKISTAN ESSENTIAL ARTICLES (CONTROL)
(SIND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1972
An
Act to amend the West Pakistan Essential Articles (Control) Act, 1958, in Its
application to the Province of Sind
[Gazette of Sind, Extraordinary, 8th December 1972]
(First
published after having received the assent of the Governor of Sind in the
Gazette of Sind (Extraordinary), dated the 8th December 1972)
1. Short title and commencement.-(1)
This Act maybe called the West Pakistan Essential Articles (Control) (Sind
Amendment) Act, 1972.
(2) It shall
come into force at once.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Essential Articles Control Sindh Amendment Act 1972
sections.description:
Amendment of section 1 of West Pakistan Act XL of 1958

ACT XVI OF 1972
ACT XVI OF 1972
WEST PAKISTAN ESSENTIAL ARTICLES (CONTROL)
(SIND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1972
An
Act to amend the West Pakistan Essential Articles (Control) Act, 1958, in Its
application to the Province of Sind
[Gazette of Sind, Extraordinary, 8th December 1972]
(First
published after having received the assent of the Governor of Sind in the
Gazette of Sind (Extraordinary), dated the 8th December 1972)
2. Amendment of section 1 of West Pakistan
Act XL of 1958.-- In the West Pakistan Essential Articles (Control) Act,
198 in its application to the Province of Sind, in section 1, in subsection
(3), for the word "fourteen", the word "nineteen" shall be
substituted.
